test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the INCORRECT statement about muscle tissue.

options.text: Muscle tissues are made up of cuboidal cells.
Microscopes reveal alternate light and dark bands in voluntary muscles.
Special contractile proteins are present in muscles.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Muscle tissues are made up of cuboidal cells.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muscle tissues** are not made up of **cuboidal cells**. Instead, they are composed of specialized elongated cells called **muscle fibers**, which are designed for contraction and movement.
 
• **Cuboidal cells** are epithelial cells, typically found in glands and ducts, where their primary function is secretion or absorption, not contraction.
 
• Muscle tissue is categorized into three types: **skeletal, smooth, and cardiac muscle**, all of which have unique structural and functional features.
 
• **Skeletal muscle fibers** are long, cylindrical, and multinucleated, with alternating light and dark bands, indicating their striated nature.
 
• **Contractile proteins**, such as **actin and myosin**, are present in all muscle tissues and are responsible for the contraction and relaxation process.
 
• Muscle tissues are integral to various bodily functions, including **movement, posture maintenance, and internal organ functioning** like the heart and digestive system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **The limbs have voluntary muscles**__

 __
 
• **Voluntary muscles**, also known as **skeletal muscles**, are under conscious control and are responsible for movements of the limbs and body.
 
• These muscles are connected to bones via **tendons** and work in pairs to perform movements like flexion and extension.
 
 
 
• **Microscopes reveal alternate light and dark bands in voluntary muscles**__
 __
 
• **Skeletal muscles** are striated, meaning they have alternating light (I-bands) and dark (A-bands) bands visible under a microscope, which are due to the arrangement of **actin and myosin filaments**.
 
• This striation is a key feature distinguishing skeletal muscles from smooth muscles, which lack this pattern.
 
 
 
• **Special contractile proteins are present in muscles**__
 
 
• Muscles contain **specialized contractile proteins** such as **actin** and **myosin**, which interact to produce contraction and generate force.
 
• Other associated proteins, like **tropomyosin** and **troponin**, help regulate the contraction process.
